name: dynamic-interview
description: Paced, multi-session interviews for understanding, planning, exploring, PoCs and debugging. Sets a goal and depth threshold up front, asks in small justified question sets, delegates fact-finding, keeps a decision ledger across sessions, and shows live progress in a pane.

interviews_dir.title: Interviews folder
interviews_dir.description: Where active interview drafts (interview.json, ledger.md) are kept. Outside your projects by default; survives plugin uninstall.

auto_allow_writes.title: Allow interview writes without asking
auto_allow_writes.description: Let Claude write interview files inside the interviews folder without a permission prompt each round. Your deny rules still apply.
